observations: White PlayStation 4 Pro console with 'PS4' and 'SONY' logos visible on the front.
Two retail boxes for 'Xbox Wireless Controller' are visible in the background.
A UK-style power plug and a coiled HDMI cable are laid out in front of the console.
The console appears to be in a retail or storage environment with a glass display case.
Watermarks for 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on the image.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a hardware failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The console may have a faulty disc drive or optical drive.
risks.proof: A video showing a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The controllers may be non-functional or have stick drift.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers being used to navigate menus or a game.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'My Account' section showing an active PSN profile.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
Video of both controllers being used to navigate menus.
Screenshot of the 'My Account' section showing an active PSN profile.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PlayStation 4 Pro from the console itself. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (non-working) until proof of operation is provided.
